facts.fact: 回到铁匠铺，Maple 迎接两人。
facts.anchor: Maple jumps into Lucan’s arms the moment we step inside his apartment.

facts.fact: Lucan 拿培根安顿 Maple，把她留在厨房。
facts.anchor: Lucan watches us with a fond smile before turning toward the kitchen.

facts.fact: Lucan 把 Micah 抱进卧室。
facts.anchor: He carries me toward his bedroom as though I weigh nothing.

facts.fact: Lucan 首次说出做爱而非单纯的欲望。
facts.anchor: “I want to make love to you.”

facts.fact: Micah 对比过往经验，认定不同。
facts.anchor: But none of the men I’ve slept with have ever treated me the way Lucan does.

facts.fact: 每一步 Lucan 都先问再做。

facts.anchor: “Like this,” I insist, pulling him closer. “Wanna see your face.”

facts.fact: 进入前 Lucan 再次确认。
facts.anchor: “Are you sure?” he asks, his brow furrowing.

facts.fact: 事后 Micah 要他别急着离开。
facts.anchor: Eventually, Lucan shifts as though to roll away.

facts.fact: Lucan 事后仍担心弄伤对方。
facts.anchor: “Did you enjoy that?” he asks quietly.
